Every App Works
Together.
By Design.

A true integrated business software suite shares one data model and one workflow engine. That's how Quikit is built — not patched together with integrations.

One shared data layer
A customer in QuikCRM is the same record in billing, support, and reports. No sync jobs. No stale data. No duplicate entry.
Live updates across apps
An action in one app instantly triggers what needs to happen in another. No webhooks to configure. No middleware to maintain.
Easy cross-app handoffs
Deal closed in CRM? A project spins up in QuikTrack. Project delivered? An invoice gets created. The system handles it.

Frequently asked questions

Here's everything you need to know to get started with Quikit's integrated business software suite.

What is an integrated business software suite?−
An integrated business software suite is a set of connected apps that run on the same platform and share the same data. Quikit includes CRM, HR, project management, marketing, and more — all in one system with no manual syncing required.
Can I start for free?+
Yes. Our Starter plan is free for up to 5 users with access to 2 apps. No credit card required. You can upgrade at any time as your team grows.
How does Quikit connect different apps?+
All apps share one data layer. A customer record in QuikCRM is the same record in billing and support. When a deal closes, QuikTrack can automatically start a project. No integrations or third-party connectors needed.
Can I switch plans at any time?+
Yes. Upgrades apply immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of your billing cycle. No penalties and no lock-in.
Is my data secure?+
Yes. Quikit is SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never sell or share your data with third parties.
Do you offer enterprise plans?+
Yes. Enterprise plans include custom user limits, dedicated support, SSO, advanced audit logs, and SLA agreements. Contact us to discuss your requirements.
Can I integrate with existing tools?+
Yes. Quikit connects with tools like Slack, Google Workspace, Stripe, and Zapier via native connectors and our REST API.
How do I get support?+
All plans include in-app chat support. Pro and Enterprise plans get priority response within 4 hours.
